description: This is a JUnit test class for the LocalStorageService in the OpenMRS project, testing storage-related functionalities such as data retrieval, deletion, and security constraints.

classes.name: LocalStorageServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing functionalities of LocalStorageService, including data retrieval, deletion handling, and security validation.

methods.name: newStorageService
methods.description: Creates a new instance of LocalStorageService for testing.

methods.name: getData_shouldReturnDataWhenLegacyFileExists
methods.description: Tests that getData correctly retrieves data from an existing legacy file.

methods.name: purgeData_shouldScheduleDeletionIfFileOpen
methods.description: Verifies that purgeData correctly schedules deletion when the file is open.

methods.name: saveData_shouldNotAllowToWriteFilesOutsideOfStorageDir
methods.description: Ensures saveData does not permit writing files outside the designated storage directory.

methods.name: getData_shouldFailIfKeyTriesToAccessFilesOutsideOfStorageDir
methods.description: Checks that getData throws an exception if the key attempts to access files outside the allowed directory.
